description: A Chinese 4G USB stick with Wi-Fi of the «UFI» kind on a Qualcomm board (05c6:f00e, manufacturer and product strings «Android»): a router inside the stick, RNDIS (rndis_host) and a DHCP address from the stick, no AT port and no cdc-wdm in this composition. Not a phone, though the strings say Android. Its web UI is at the stick's gateway (192.168.100.1 on the owner's unit, login admin/admin); signal, operator and SMS stay inside the stick until its web is read. Router mode is this stick's only mode: no problem to report. Field report 2026-10-19 (the owner's bench, OpenWrt 25.12.5 on sunxi, diag report usb_1.2): rndis_host on interfaces 00 and 01, gateway 192.168.100.1, DNS from the stick. Imported catalog composition 05c6:f00e (generic-hilink)
